mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = 'OPEN' AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND c.status = 'OPEN'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_post WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
